detailZones.title: Basketball wall
detailZones.description: Inspect the wall-mounted backboard, hoop, net, braces and blue wall protection.

detailZones.title: Wall ladders and ropes
detailZones.description: Follow the timber wall ladders, rungs, mounting hardware and three hanging climbing ropes.

detailZones.title: Balls and rack
detailZones.description: Inspect the wheeled ball trolley, shelves, dividers, handles, casters and visible colored balls.

detailZones.title: Mats and vaulting box
detailZones.description: Explore the stacked tumbling mats, mat cart, handles, straps, vaulting box tiers and a low gym bench.

detailZones.title: Volleyball and equipment storage
detailZones.description: Follow the volleyball posts, rolled net, equipment-store shelves, cones, hoops, agility gear and trolley.

detailZones.title: Court and room fittings
detailZones.description: Inspect the sprung floor, court lines, ceiling services, clerestory windows, doors and store fittings.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized gymnasium photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 150 independently pointable basketball, wall-ladder, rope, ball, mat, vaulting, volleyball, storage, court and room-fixture parts across 6 bounded zones. Student identity, activity state, scores, signage, brands, school policy and hidden equipment functions were excluded.
